name: Bulk Edit Product For Woocommerce
author: theme funda

sections.description:
Easily bulk edit multiple fields for WooCommerce products in one go. Save time by updating multiple product attributes through an intuitive and user-friendly interface.

Editable Fields:
– Name
– Price
– Regular Price
– Sale Price
– Weight (kg)
– Length
– Width
– Height
– Stock Status
– Allow Backorders
– Tax Status
– Tax Classes
– Stock Quantity
– SKU
– Manage Stock Option
– Sold Individually Setting

Features:
– Update fields for multiple products simultaneously.
– Intuitive interface to streamline bulk product management.
– Filter and search products for targeted updates.
– Compatible with variable and simple products.

This plugin is ideal for WooCommerce store owners looking to manage their catalog efficiently, especially when dealing with large inventories.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Go to Products > Bulk Edit to start managing product fields.
sections.faq:
Can I edit variable products?

Yes, the plugin supports bulk editing for variable and simple products.

Does this plugin support custom fields?

Currently, only the listed fields are editable. Support for custom fields may be added in future updates.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with support for editing the following fields: Name, Price, Regular Price, Sale Price, Weight, Dimensions, Stock Settings, SKU, and more.
